    Theorem A from the three remaining nodes #

    Theorem A, Corollary 1.1 and the radical corollary follow from CriticalNode, HullNode (interval-finiteness of the universal cover) and D7Node (unbounded supports over representation-finite pieces give a monomial band). Gabriel's covering theorem is proved (lineNode_of).
